description: In response to the Majority’s passage of a sweeping omnibus bill on correction reform,Assemblyman David DiPietro (R,C-East Aurora) issued his criticism, calling the legislation “ablatant failure to address the very issues that forced thousands of correctional officers to risk their livelihoods and walk off the job.”The bill comes in the wake of the largest correctional officer strike New York State hasseen in decades. title: DiPietro: ‘No-Vote’ on Majority’s Omnibus Corrections Bill
